author: Maya K.
body: The cedar bath alone is worth the trip. The kaiseki dinner was a quiet revelation.

author: Tomás S.
body: Tucked away from the crowds — exactly what we needed. Staff anticipated everything.

author: Amelia R.
body: Rooftop is dreamy at sunset. Breakfast pastries from the bakery next door.

author: Henrik L.
body: Felt like staying with friends in their lake house. Boat ride at sunrise was unforgettable.

author: Yara A.
body: Stunning tiles and the pool made the heat manageable. Souk noise carries a bit at night.

author: Birgit J.
body: We saw the aurora from the hot tub. The hosts brought us hot chocolate at midnight.
